# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-1, from
# tools/vivado-parity/muxf.sh. `cell` lines are its own report (BEL and pin
# drivers, from muxf_probe.tcl), with the sites taken off; `slice` lines are
# its bitstream decoded through this repository's database, one line per
# wide multiplexer: tests/fpga_xray_muxf.rs says how to read one. `delay`
# lines are from its report of the worst path.
design f7_carry
  cell MUXF7 bel F7AMUX
  cell I0 from LUT2/O@B6LUT
  cell I1 from LUT6/O@A6LUT
  cell S from a flip-flop
  cell O to LUT6/I5@C6LUT
  cell counts BUFG 1 CARRY4 2 FDRE 30 GND 1 IBUF 2 LUT2 9 LUT4 1 LUT6 2 MUXF7 1 OBUF 1 VCC 1
  slice f7 I0=32 I1=31 out=out select=reached:alone
  delay Prop_muxf7_I1_O 0.214
design f7_d
  cell MUXF7 bel F7AMUX
  cell I0 from LUT6/O@B6LUT
  cell I1 from LUT6/O@A6LUT
  cell S from a flip-flop
  cell O to FDRE/D@A5FF LUT3/I1@A6LUT
  cell counts BUFG 1 FDRE 16 GND 1 IBUF 2 LUT3 1 LUT6 2 MUXF7 1 OBUF 1 VCC 1
  slice f7 I0=32 I1=31 out=out select=reached:alone
  delay Prop_muxf7_I0_O 0.209
design f7_fanout

  slice f7 I0=32 I1=31 out=out select=reached:alone
  delay Prop_muxf7_I0_O 0.209
